newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale still off at 1300 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale still off at 1300 GMT.

text.p: The auction of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) was still suspended at 1000 local/1300 GMT, the time scheduled for the sale to start, officials said.

Jose Pio Borges, privatization director of the National Development Bank (BNDES), said in a statement government lawyers were still trying to fight a host of injunctions issued against the sale by courts across the country.
"As soon as the injunctions are revoked, the BNDES will immediately authorize the auction to take place," Borges said.
Early in the morning, BNDES officials said five of nine injunctions issued Monday had been revoked. But on Tuesday, several other courts around Brazil issued several new injunctions.
